control: 'Brands and menu' link of the admin top bar (GET /admin/menu): the catalogue part
inputs_validation: none to type; admin only; read only; archived brands and dishes are listed too (BR-19)
displayed_result: Brand table (name, Rename field and button, Archive), dish table (name with description, brand, price, Edit and Archive), the 'Menus per hub' links and the forms 'Add brand' and 'New dish'; archived rows are muted with an Archived badge and no actions

inputs_validation: name required, at most 60 characters; no other brand, archived ones included, may have the same name (BR-19 keeps archived names)
displayed_result: Redirect to the catalogue with 'The brand is created.' and the new brand row; a refusal such as 'A brand called X already exists.' shows as a red message on the catalogue and writes nothing

inputs_validation: name required, at most 60 characters, not used by another brand; the brand must be active; orders already placed keep the old name (BR-19)
displayed_result: Redirect to the catalogue with 'The brand is renamed.' and the new name in the row and in the dish table

control: 'Archive' button of a brand row (confirm dialog, POST /admin/brands/<id>/archive)
inputs_validation: brand must be active; its dishes can no longer be listed or ordered, past order lines are not touched (BR-19)
displayed_result: Redirect to the catalogue with 'The brand is archived. Its dishes can no longer be ordered.'; the brand row stays, muted, with the Archived badge and no Rename or Archive

control: 'New dish' button and 'Edit' links (GET /admin/menu): the catalogue part before a dish form opens
inputs_validation: none to type; admin only; read only
displayed_result: The same catalogue page as A01, from where the 'New dish' button opens the empty dish form and 'Edit' opens the form of one dish

control: 'Save dish' button of the new dish form (GET and POST /admin/items/new)
inputs_validation: brand chosen and active; dish name required, at most 60 characters, new within the brand; description at most 200; price a whole number of 1 to 1,000,000 VND (BR-19); refusals keep the typed values and write nothing
displayed_result: Valid: redirect to the catalogue with 'The dish is created. List it at a hub so customers can order it.'; refused (400): the form with a red box, for example 'The price must be between 1 and 1,000,000 VND.'

control: 'Edit' link of a dish row and 'Save dish' button (GET and POST /admin/items/<id>)
inputs_validation: the dish and its brand must be active; the hidden brand field must match the current brand, a dish never moves to another brand; name, description and price rules as for a new dish; a new price applies to new orders only, existing lines keep their snapshot (BR-19)
displayed_result: Form filled with the saved values and the line 'Com Tam Corner · a new price applies to new orders only'; after saving, redirect to the catalogue with 'The dish is saved. Orders already placed keep their old name and price.'

control: 'Archive' button of a dish row (confirm dialog, POST /admin/items/<id>/archive)
inputs_validation: dish must exist and be active; past order lines are not touched (BR-19)
displayed_result: Redirect to the catalogue with 'The dish is archived. It can no longer be ordered.'; the dish row stays, muted, with the Archived badge and no Edit or Archive

inputs_validation: hub id in the URL; unknown id gives 'Hub not found.' (404); read only; archived dishes still listed at the hub show an Archived badge
displayed_result: 'Menu of <hub>': table of listed dishes with brand, price, status (Available, Sold out, Archived), 'Sold out' or 'Available' and 'Remove from menu'; the 'Add to menu' form offers only active dishes of active brands that are not listed yet; an empty menu says the hub cannot take orders

inputs_validation: hub active, dish active, its brand active, dish not on this hub's menu yet; availability 1 or 0 (BR-19, active parents)
displayed_result: Redirect to the hub menu with 'The dish is on the hub's menu.' and the new row Available or Sold out; a refusal such as 'already on the menu of <hub>' shows as a red message

control: 'Sold out' / 'Available' link-button of a listed dish (POST /admin/hubs/<id>/menu/<item>/availability)
inputs_validation: available is 0 or 1 (anything else is refused); hub not archived; dish and brand active; the dish must be listed (BR-19)
displayed_result: Redirect to the hub menu with 'Availability updated.'; the status badge changes (Available green, Sold out red) and the button shows the opposite action

control: 'Remove from menu' button of a listed dish (POST /admin/hubs/<id>/menu/<item>/remove)
inputs_validation: hub must exist; the dish must be listed or 'This dish is not on the hub's menu.' (404); the listing row is the only thing deleted, orders keep their lines (BR-19)
displayed_result: Redirect to the hub menu with 'The dish is off the hub's menu.'; the row is gone and the dish appears again in the 'Add to menu' choices
